titulo: Ford job cuts in Europe: 3,800 planned vs $5.3B payouts
caption:
Ford job cuts in Europe: 3,800 planned vs $5.3B payouts

Ford job cuts in Europe, Feb 2023: Ford planned 3,800 job cuts there, and paid $5.3 billion to shareholders that same year.

From the archive: Feb 2023. Not today's news.

Ford, Feb 14, 2023 (Ford Europe, news release): "creating a leaner, more competitive cost structure"

Is Ford cutting jobs in Europe? In its Feb. 14, 2023 release, Ford said it would eliminate 3,800 jobs in Europe over three years. Its 2023 Form 10-K (the annual report public companies file with the SEC) reports $5.3 billion in shareholder distributions that year, company-wide: cash dividends plus anti-dilutive share repurchases (buybacks, when a company buys its own shares).

The math: $5.3 billion in dividends and buybacks (2023, company-wide) ÷ 3,800 planned job cuts (Europe, over three years) = about $1.39 million in dividends and buybacks per job cut. A ratio, not a cause.

The scopes differ: the $5.3 billion is company-wide for all of 2023; the 3,800 jobs are in Europe, over three years.

Leaner and more competitive. Here is the payout column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.
